pediatric: 8.4 Pediatric Use The safety and effectiveness of NUFYMCO in pediatric patients have not been established.
contra: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Ocular or periocular infections ( 4.1 ) Hypersensitivity ( 4.2 ) 4.1 Ocular or Periocular Infections NUFYMCO is contraindicated in patients with ocular or periocular infections. 4.2 Hypersensitivity NUFYMCO is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to ranibizumab products or any of the excipients in NUFYMCO. Hypersensitivity reactions may manifest as severe intraocular inflammation.
interactions: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Drug interaction studies have not been conducted with ranibizumab products. Ranibizumab intravitreal injection has been used adjunctively with PDT. Twelve of 105 (11%) patients with neovascular AMD developed serious intraocular inflammation; in 10 of the 12 patients, this occurred when ranibizumab was administered 7 days (± 2 days) after PDT.
